extracted.name: Simple Butter Cream Frosting
extracted.description: This quick and easy buttercream frosting is made with margarine and shortening for the classic bakery-style flavor and texture.
instruction_lines: Beat margarine and shortening together in a large bowl until light and fluffy. Add salt and vanilla extract.
Gradually beat in confectioners’ sugar, alternating with milk, until frosting is smooth, light, and spreadable.
